description:
New packages/provider-speechmatics implementing LiveSpeechProvider, modeled on packages/provider-soniox.

- Auth: long-lived key from SecretStore ("speechmatics_api_key") -> temp RT JWT (ttl ~1 h, refresh on reconnect). testSpeechmaticsKey: smallest authenticated call, sanitized message (as testSonioxKey).
- StartRecognition: audio_format raw pcm_s16le 16000; transcription_config { language, diarization: "speaker", enable_partials, max_delay, operating_point from option id }.
- Normalizer (like SonioxNormalizer): AddPartialTranscript -> provisional tokens (replaceProvisional), AddTranscript -> final tokens with sample times (seconds * 16000 + connection startSample), speaker labels -> SpeechEvent turns with provider labels scoped per connection (S<conn>-<label>, same rule as Soniox; IMPLEMENTATION.md "Soniox speaker labels are scoped per connection"). EndOfUtterance -> speech-activity events.
- Reconnect with the ring buffer + storage replay and 1 s overlap exactly like SonioxRun; consider extracting that ring/replay/backoff into a shared helper in @irl/domain or a small package rather than copying.
- capabilities: { transcription: "streaming", diarization: "fused-with-stt", persistentIdentity: true, languages: supported list, execution: "cloud" }.
- Registry options speechmatics:standard / speechmatics:enhanced (or current model names from the spike) with provides vad + stt-final.
- app.json whitelist entries + permission desc mention Speechmatics.
- Tests: normalizer against recorded JSON fixtures from the spike; reconnect/overlap dedupe.

Done when: selecting Speechmatics live captions records a conversation end to end on device with captions, speaker turns, and local voice matching over Speechmatics ranges (fused path).
title: Speechmatics live provider: realtime STT and diarization
